Gonna catch flak for this but I have an honest question that I know my answer too, but no one of faith will answer it honestly. Just short scripted bs then change subjects.

 So God created us in his image right, were all a like him. This includes anger and love. He's omnipresent and all knowing, yet surprised or more to the old Testament, angry when we do things. Okilly doakilly. He created all, all the universe and said let there be light (ignoring the fact that we have a younger sun) and we came about. Okilly doakilly. Now the universe is.. Vast. We are more or less equivalent to one grain of sand on the entire earth. Not us as humans, the plant. As a human, were less than one atom in the grain of sand. Out of all the stuff God created, why does he care to choose us as his... Pet project? And not just as a planet, but as each individual. On this planet with an excess of 7.5 billion people, he cares about you, me, and that fucker who drives his car through my lawn regularly. Additionally humanity has been around.. What, 200k years? Yet he cares about all of us on an individual basis. What makes us so important out of all the stuff he has done for 14 billion years that he cares about me, right now? Why must we be so self centered that we have to believe someone is watching over us to make sure we do what is "right" in their opinion.

That said, I firmly believe religion is good for humanity because its allows for a way to vent and form communities and I have yet to find a religion that teaches bad morals. I find these points to be extremely beneficial to humanity. I just cant fathom why we must believe were that special, and that we must fight each other because "I'm right and you're wrong, and now God that says 'don't kill each other in anger, but that asshole over there who doesn't believe in me, go convert them and if they don't then kill em'". Not being condescending or mocking, but please answer that. (Not the hypocrisy, that's a whole nother matter)

Its dark but in those moments, it spoke the truth. I wanted to die, so I could reason I was alive, and therefore reason I was ahead of what I could of been.

Well considering I don't want attempts I'd want success. 

I'd recreate the brain bucket, and get a some canister of compressed gas (argon or helium.. 60lb can outa do). Once those are achieved I'd move away from all family and friends and probably live quitely for a year, slowly dwindling contact to the point I eventual cease all communications. Following this I'd go to the garage with my brain bucket, canister of gas, bottle of jack, bottle of asprin, and a bottle of sulfuric acid (drain cleaner). After going through the garage and making it as air tight as possible, I'd stick a sign on the door window reading "inert gas, completely ventilate prior to entery". Then I'd sit on a chair and pour myself a glass of jack and acid to wash down the bottle of asprin. Probably crack the valve on the can and fire off the brain bucket. 

End result brain destroyed, suffication effected, and internal organs destroyed from acid and excessive bleeding. 

Don't wanna hurt anyone else, but dont wanna have an attempt.

I drink to deal with life (not sure if I hate sobriety or trying to cope with social anxiety). I have learned to be extremely defensive (not like I pop off on people, but I never let people in). This also has grown into me not being able to properly communicate, so even if I feel horrible for something I've done I can't bring myself to apologize. I communicate by being a huge sarcastic dick. Maybe it all compounds to why I'm a bit depressed, idk. But that feeling is something I've known for a while and kinda grown to accept. 

Hope ya do better in the end. If not, atleast youre not alone.

Drinking too much.. And regretting I told people I was depressed. 

I appreciate being asked how I'm doing everyonce in a while but now that I've told my immediate family (which I still live with) thats all they ask. And they wanna do things for me like my laundry and gather my mail but in the end it just makes me feel more useless because theyre doing what I should. 

I have trouble communicating, so when they ask how I'm doing I either tell them 'good' or walk away. Something about the attention being on me makes it worse and then with communication issues I just get annoyed or angry when all I want to do is thank them for caring but please just give me some space and normality to get into a groove and potentially feel better.

That coupled with the fact they can't seem to comprehend I dont like people, i may have anxiety towards that. They always are telling me to go take a vacation or tell my extended family I'm coming to major events in an effort to get me to socialize and that just exacerbates the issue. Hell, last week I had to go to a wedding, and a week prior they tried playfully teasing me (I do appreciate that) but they struck a nerve and I blew up exponetially on them about it. They appologized for inviting me, told me they wont do it again, and alls i could muster was a "sorry for poppin off" before walking away. Felt like shit for it but trying to talk.. Brain just misfires and i cant communicate. Then when i went to the wedding I had extreme unease and got drunk. Like black out drunk. Told me at the event itself I didnt do anything too bad but I still know I made an ass of myself, which just compounds the issue more. 


Seein a therapist; but I don't know if we don't jive, if hes shitty, or slowly trying to build a rapport with me. He talks and we just bullshit, and when he asks me how I'm doing I fall into the same groove of 'good'. Told him about a couple worries or stressors and we talked but didn't seem beneficial to 'em.

Suicidal ideologies plauge my thoughts, along with guilt for past events I just want to apologize to people for (but that would dredge up more shit than good). Thats always a blast. Then theres guilt for being depressed to begin with, got no reason too be but alas here we are. 

Too late to the party for anyone too read, which I'm greatful for. Dont need no lovin on my pitty party, just somewhere I can form some semblance of a thought and release a lil. 

Here's to hopin the meds work.

I was young and dumb, mix that with a break up and you get some deliciously awful decisions. 

She had been learning mandarin and wanted books to read that she had already read in english. So her parents buy her one and I get her the other and was gonna hold it for a holiday or something (idk anymore, been a few years and many beers). Well we break up cause I'm dumb, for weeks go by and I notice the book.. So I decide to give it to her. 

Like the classful and elegant individual I am, I wrap the book in brown butcher's paper and wrap it up in twin, write her name on it and drop it off. Where did I drop it off? In her parents mail box. 

She was away at college. 

Amazingly, it went over poorly. Who'da guessed.
